CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 1

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

3. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 1

4. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 7
   C. 19
   D. 17

6. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

7. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

8. Solve for x: x + 7 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 12

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 156

11. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

13. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 2

14. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 32

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 169

16. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 1
   D. 56

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
